title: UNDER THE HIGHTOWER // THE CLOCKWORK CELESTIAL VAULT
narrative: Three levels beneath the vaults of the Seneschal's Court, behind a vault door of meteoric iron, Sam held aloft a sputtering candle. Before him turned an astronomical wonder from ancient Valyria: a three-story brass astrolabe with spinning concentric rings charting the heavens, powered by geothermal steam from beneath the Honeywine. As the brass globes aligned, a beam of light refracted through a prism of cut obsidian, projecting a map of Planetos onto the vaulted ceiling. The map revealed the seasonal anomaly: an ancient astronomical misalignment of a shattered second moon that caused the long, erratic winters.
resolvesPlotHole: The Astronomical Reason for Westerosi Seasons
